description: Image Description: The image depicts a public bathroom with a modern and minimalistic design. There is an orange countertop with two white sinks embedded in it. Each sink has a metal faucet. Above the countertop is a large mirror that spans the length of the counter. The walls are covered with small beige and brown square tiles, giving the space a textured look. On the left side, a metal hand dryer and a paper towel dispenser are mounted on the wall. A small light fixture is visible above the mirror
